# Tabbed Header

## Summary
A card header that carries a tab strip for switching between views of one card.

## Shape
Combines the identity row with a tab list, so a multi-view card gets both without stacking two
headers. `@tabs` is an array of `{ displayName, tabId }`, `@activeTabId` names the current one
and `@setActiveTab(tabId)` is called to change it — selection state stays with the consumer.
`@headerTitle` and `@headerBackgroundColor` cover presentation, and the `headerIcon` and
`sideContent` blocks carry the icon and any trailing controls. It owns the tab affordance
itself, so tabs behave alike in every card that has them.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/tabbed-header/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { TabbedHeader } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
